properties.name: Japheth's Descendants (Europe/Asia)
properties.popup: Japhethites spread north and west - Genesis 10:2-5
properties.description: Japheth's sons: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, Tiras. They spread to Europe and Asia Minor.
properties.archaeology: Javan = Greeks (Ionians); Madai = Medes; Gomer = Cimmerians; identifications well-established.

properties.name: Ham's Descendants (Africa/Canaan)
properties.description: Ham's sons: Cush, Mizraim, Put, Canaan. They settled Africa and the land of Canaan.
properties.archaeology: Mizraim = Egypt; Cush = Ethiopia/Nubia; Put = Libya; Canaan = Palestine. Clear ancient attestations.

properties.name: Nimrod's Kingdom - Babel
properties.description: Nimrod son of Cush was a mighty one. His kingdom began with Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh in Shinar.
properties.archaeology: Babel = Babylon; Erech = Uruk; Accad = Akkad. These cities are archaeologically confirmed.

properties.name: Nineveh (Nimrod's expansion)
properties.popup: Nimrod built Nineveh in Assyria - Genesis 10:11-12
properties.description: From Shinar, Nimrod went to Assyria and built Nineveh, Rehoboth-Ir, Calah, and Resen.
properties.archaeology: Nineveh excavated extensively - massive Assyrian capital with palaces and library of Ashurbanipal.

properties.name: Shem's Descendants (Middle East)
properties.description: Shem's descendants: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram. Through Arphaxad came Abraham and the Hebrews.
properties.archaeology: Elam = Persia; Asshur = Assyria; Aram = Syria. Semitic peoples dominated the ancient Near East.

properties.name: Land of Canaan (Ham's son)
properties.description: Canaan's descendants: Sidon, Heth, Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites, Hivites, and more. They occupied the Promised Land.
properties.archaeology: These peoples are well-attested in Egyptian and Mesopotamian records as inhabitants of Canaan.
